item.title: Why Leo Fioravanti Uses Fashion to Keep Surfing Light
item.description: Leo Fioravanti says to win at surfing these days, you have to be an athlete 100 percent of the time. That's why he uses other outlets to keep the sport fun.

item.title: Norrøna Lofoten Gore-Tex Pro Ski Jacket Review: A Backcountry Jacket Built for Hard Days on the Mountain
item.description: Designed for serious skiers and storm days, the Norrøna Lofoten Gore-Tex Pro ski jacket combines elite protection and ventilation with refined, hard-charging design.

item.title: Woman ‘Skysurfs’ Above Mount Everest to Break World Record
item.description: Belarusian skysurfer Olga Naumova smashed the record for highest skysurfing jump in a jump above Mount Everest.

item.title: It Snowed in New York City So These Guys Went Snowboarding In Central Park
item.description: Honestly, somebody get a winch and call the people at Red Bull. Central Park could be the best spot ever for a Red Bull Heavy Metal event.

item.title: Human Head Found on Beach in Western Australia
item.description: A human head discovered on a beach in Western Australia is believed to belong to a snorkeler who disappeared in the area several days earlier.

item.title: How to Score in Australia on Your Snowboard
item.description: KORUA Shapes makes a handful of surfy snowboards, so when they went to Thredbo Mountain in Australia, it was a perfect chance to put them through the paces.

item.title: The Da Hui Backdoor Shootout Is On!
item.description: The Da Hui Backdoor Shootout got started today at Pipeline on the North Shore. Surfers compete in a unique competition format.

item.title: Candide Thovex and a So-Called ‘Mellow Day’ in Tignes, France
item.description: Candide Thovex is one of the best skiers in the world. His technical skill is a part of that, but more so is his creativity. In Tignes, France, it's on display.

item.title: This Is Ari Browne Surfing a Weird Little Fish That Positively Flies
item.description: Ari Browne is a fantastically good surfer. In this edit from Mollusk Surf Shop, his talent is on full display as he rides a funny little fish shape.

item.title: Video: Man Drops Wedding Ring 118 Feet Onto Ski Slope During Proposal
item.description: A romantic holiday wedding proposal immediately went awry, when a Michigan man dropped the ring off a skybridge onto a ski slope 188 feet below.
